  $__time(ts),
  (sensors->>'Reactor Coolant')::double precision AS "Reactor Coolant",
  (sensors->>'Reactor Feed Rate')::double precision AS "Reactor Feed Rate",
  (sensors->>'Reactor Pressure')::double precision AS "Reactor Pressure",
  (sensors->>'Reactor Coolant Temp')::double precision AS "Reactor Coolant Temp",

  (sensors->>'Reactor Temperature')::double precision AS "Reactor Temperature"

WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts;
